exposure: triglyceride-glucose (TyG) index > 8.6 during the first trimester of pregnancy
cohort: A cohort of 333 pregnant women in Mexico City was divided into two groups based on their first-trimester TyG index.
finding: A first-trimester TyG index > 8.6 was significantly associated with an increased risk of gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and preeclampsia.
mod_finding: No significant association was found between an elevated TyG index and cesarean delivery.
